description: React component for rendering individual file search result items in Mattermost, including preview, download, and contextual menu functionalities.

classes.name: FileSearchResultItem
classes.description: React component class for displaying a file search result with preview, download, and menu options.

methods.name: jumpToConv
methods.description: Navigates to the channel post associated with the file.

methods.name: copyLink
methods.description: Copies the link to the file post to clipboard.

methods.name: stopPropagation
methods.description: Stops event propagation for click events.

methods.name: keepOpen
methods.description: Sets the keepOpen state to control menu visibility.

methods.name: renderPluginItems
methods.description: Renders plugin menu items if applicable.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the entire file search result item UI.
